Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo

Hi Marissa,

We just signed up for Redwood and are evaluating options for a Dedicated deployment. We run a high-throughput inference workload (roughly 450-600 qps at peak across multiple routes) and are targeting p95 latency < 150ms for short prompts (~256 tokens). We chose the Dedicated option because of the data isolation and predictable throughput.

Can you set up a demo that focuses on throughput/latency behavior, batching/queueing, and what kind of SLA/observability we can expect? We'd also like to see the autoscaling and fallback behavior under load.

Availability: our engineering lead (me) and our Head of ML, Priya, are available Wed-Fri next week in the mornings PST.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson

alex.johnson@opticai.com
